tasks.task:
This function has exactly one defect. Name the defect and explain how to fix it.

```python
def reserve(pool, node_id, amount):
    # pool.remaining() and pool.take() are each individually thread-safe
    if pool.remaining() >= amount:
        pool.take(amount)
        return True
    return False
```
tasks.expectation: Identifies the check-then-act race (TOCTOU): between remaining() and take() another thread can take the capacity, so two callers can both pass the check and overdraw the pool. Individually thread-safe calls do not compose. Fix is to hold a lock across both, or use an atomic compare-and-take. Answers that say the individual calls need locking have MISSED it.

Identifies that the same absolute deadline (or full timeout) is passed to every attempt rather than being decremented by time already elapsed, so the total wall time is up to attempts x deadline instead of bounded by deadline. Fix is to track remaining time and pass the shrinking budget, aborting when it reaches zero. Answers about missing backoff or catching too-narrow an exception have NOT found the stated defect.
